everfeast.title: EverFeast - Privacy Policy
everfeast.intro1: This Privacy Policy applies to the mobile game <1>EverFeast</1> (package name: <2>com.hck.infiniterestaurant</2>) ("App"), developed and published by <1>HCK Applications</1> ("we", "our", or "Developer").
everfeast.intro2: Your privacy is of paramount importance to us. This document has been prepared in full compliance with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (<1>KVKK</1> No. 6698), the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (<1>GDPR</1>), the California Consumer Privacy Act (<1>CCPA/CPRA</1>), the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (<1>COPPA</1>), as well as <1>Google Play Developer Policies</1> and <1>Apple App Store Review Guidelines</1>.
everfeast.intro3: By downloading, installing, or using our Application, you agree to the data processing practices described in this Privacy Policy.
everfeast.section1Text: The data controller responsible for the processing of your personal data is:
everfeast.section1Footer: For any data requests, deletion requests, or privacy inquiries, please contact us via the email address above.
everfeast.section2Title: 2. Information We Collect and Purposes of Collection
everfeast.section2Text1: You do <1>NOT</1> need to create a user account (email, password, etc.) to play EverFeast. Our game is designed to run directly on your device.
everfeast.section2Text2: However, in order for the game to function technically, prevent crashes, deliver in-app purchases, and display advertisements, data in the following categories is collected and processed:
everfeast.section2ATitle: A. Automatically Collected Technical and Analytics Data
everfeast.section2AText: When you open and use the App, the following data may be automatically collected through the third-party services we integrate:
everfeast.section2AItem1: Device and Hardware Information: Device make/model, operating system and version, system language, screen resolution, and performance.
everfeast.section2AItem2: Network and Location Data: IP address (processed solely by third-party services for approximate country/city level geolocation and fraud prevention; your precise GPS location is never collected).
everfeast.section2AItem3: Identifiers: Google Advertising ID (AAID / GAID), Apple Identifier for Advertisers (IDFA), Firebase Installation ID (App Instance ID), and RevenueCat Anonymous Customer ID (App User ID).
everfeast.section2AItem4: Usage and Gameplay Activity: Game session duration, restaurant levels achieved, prestige reset counts, achievements unlocked, in-game store pack views, and ad viewing statistics.
everfeast.section2BTitle: B. In-App Purchases and Financial Information
everfeast.section2BItem1: You can purchase digital content such as diamond packs within the App.
everfeast.section2BItem2: Credit Card / Payment Information: All payment and billing transactions are managed by Google Play Store (Android) or Apple App Store (iOS). As the developer, we have absolutely no access to your credit card, debit card, or billing details, and this information is never stored on our servers.
everfeast.section2BItem3: Solely for the purpose of validating purchases and crediting items to your account, transaction receipts (receipt/token), purchase timestamps, currency, and purchased package IDs are processed through RevenueCat infrastructure.
everfeast.section2CTitle: C. Error and Crash Diagnostic Data
everfeast.section2CItem1: In the event of an unexpected error or crash during gameplay, technical diagnostic reports are collected.
everfeast.section2CItem2: These reports include the code line where the error occurred, stack traces, memory status, and the device operating system version at the time of the crash.
everfeast.section2DItem1: Support Inquiries: When you contact us via hckapplications@gmail.com, the email address and message content you provide are used solely to resolve your issue.
everfeast.section2DItem2: Game Services Sign-In: If you choose to sign in with your Google Play Games or Apple Game Center account, your player nickname (gamer tag) and cloud save data are synchronized with these services.
everfeast.section3Text: To enable certain functionalities of our App, Software Development Kits (SDKs) from trusted third-party service providers are utilized. The data processing policies of these providers are detailed below:
everfeast.section3_1Purpose: Purpose: Serving in-game advertisements (particularly rewarded video ads initiated voluntarily by players to earn extra rewards).
everfeast.section3_1Data: Data Processed: Advertising identifiers (AAID/IDFA), IP address, ad view and interaction metrics, cookies, and similar mobile technologies.
everfeast.section3_2Purpose: Purpose: Improving gameplay experience, analyzing stages where players struggle, dynamically updating game settings over-the-air, and enabling conversion attribution.
everfeast.section3_2Data: Data Processed: Firebase Installation ID (App Instance ID), session data, in-game events (e.g., prestige_sell, diamond_pack, rewarded_ad), device specifications.
everfeast.section3_3Purpose: Purpose: Validating in-app purchases, app store receipts, and delivering digital products.
everfeast.section3_3Data: Data Processed: Anonymous user ID, purchase receipts, transaction timestamp, product identifiers.
everfeast.section3_4Title: 4. GlitchTip / Sentry SDK (GlitchTip & Functional Software, Inc.)
everfeast.section3_4Purpose: Purpose: Real-time monitoring and resolution of game crashes, runtime exceptions, and purchase/data-saving errors.
everfeast.section3_4Data: Data Processed: Error diagnostic data, stack traces, device model, operating system.
everfeast.section3_4Note: Privacy Note: Session tracking in GlitchTip is disabled in our App, and sensitive personal information is filtered out.
everfeast.section3_5Title: 5. Google Play Games Services (Google LLC) and Apple Game Center (Apple Inc.)
everfeast.section3_5Purpose: Purpose: Offering achievements, leaderboards, and a single Cloud Save slot so players can carry their progress across devices.
everfeast.section3_5Data: Data Processed: Player account identifier, game save data, scores.
everfeast.section4Title: 4. Critical Data Association Disclosure (Firebase and RevenueCat Integration)
everfeast.section4Notice: In accordance with our principle of transparency and Google Play / App Store requirements, this data connection is explicitly disclosed:
everfeast.section4Intro: To maintain purchase security, prevent fraudulent transactions, and measure which ad or campaign interaction led to a purchase (Google Ads conversion optimization):
everfeast.section4Item1: The Firebase App Instance ID generated upon installation is transmitted to the RevenueCat library (Purchases.setFirebaseAppInstanceId).
everfeast.section4Item2: The Anonymous Customer ID (App User ID) generated by RevenueCat is set as the user identifier (setUserId) in Firebase Analytics.
everfeast.section4OutroItem1: Your name, surname, phone number, email address, or payment card details are NEVER shared.
everfeast.section4OutroItem2: Only two randomly generated anonymous alphanumeric codes (IDs) are mapped to each other.
everfeast.section4OutroItem3: This mapping is conducted solely for statistical analysis, advertising efficiency measurement, and safeguarding your purchase entitlements.
everfeast.section5Text: The App requests minimal permissions from your device to operate:
everfeast.section5Item1: Internet Access (android.permission.INTERNET): Required to load advertisements, validate purchases, and send diagnostic reports.
everfeast.section5Item2: Billing Permission (com.android.vending.BILLING): Required to make in-app purchases through the Google Play Store.
everfeast.section5Item3: Notification Permission (android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS): Enables sending local notifications regarding offline restaurant revenue or return-to-game reminders. Notifications are scheduled entirely locally on your device (flutter_local_notifications); no personal data is transmitted to external notification servers. You can disable notifications at any time in the in-game Settings menu or in your device's Notification Settings.
everfeast.section5Item4: Receive Boot Completed (android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED): Used to restore scheduled local reminders when your device restarts.
everfeast.section5Item5: Local Data Storage (SQLite & SharedPreferences): Your gameplay progress, kitchen upgrades, and sound/music preferences are stored directly on your phone's internal memory.
everfeast.section6Text1: EverFeast is an idle/simulation game intended for a general audience. The App does NOT knowingly or intentionally collect personally identifiable information from children under 13 years of age (or under 16 years of age where required by local jurisdiction).
everfeast.section6Text2: If you are a parent or guardian and become aware that your child has provided us with personal data without your consent, please contact us immediately at hckapplications@gmail.com. Upon detection, such data and identifiers will be promptly deleted from our systems and third-party records.
everfeast.section7Item1: Security Measures: Your personal and technical data are transmitted to third-party infrastructures using industry-standard encryption protocols (HTTPS / TLS).
everfeast.section7Item2: Retention Period: Local game save files remain on your device until you uninstall the App or clear application data. Analytics and diagnostic logs are retained in accordance with Google Firebase and GlitchTip standard data retention policies (typically between 2 and 14 months) and are thereafter automatically deleted or completely anonymized.
everfeast.section7Item3: Data Selling: HCK Applications does NOT sell, rent, or trade any user personal data to third parties for commercial gain.
everfeast.section8Intro: Depending on your country of residence (under KVKK, GDPR, or CCPA/CPRA), you possess the following rights:
everfeast.section8Item1: Information and Access: The right to learn the scope of personal data processed about you.
everfeast.section8Item2: Correction and Deletion (Right to be Forgotten): The right to request correction of inaccurate data or deletion of collected data.
everfeast.section8Item3_Android: Android: Settings -> Google -> Ads -> Reset advertising ID or Delete advertising ID / Turn off Ads Personalization.
everfeast.section8Item3_iOS: iOS: Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Tracking -> Turn off 'Allow Apps to Request to Track'.
everfeast.section8Item4: Right to Object: The right to object to the processing of your data or withdraw your consent at any time.
everfeast.section8Footer: You can submit all such requests by writing to hckapplications@gmail.com. Your requests will be answered free of charge within 30 days in compliance with legal regulations.
everfeast.section9Text1: As the Developer, we reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy from time to time in accordance with legal requirements or new features introduced to the App.
everfeast.section9Text2: When the policy is updated, the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page will be revised. In case of significant changes, necessary notifications will be provided inside the App or via update release notes.
everfeast.section10Text: For any questions, feedback, or data deletion requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
